title: Unverified financial figures ship with contradictory 'VERIFY before prod' TODO markers
detail: The header asserts every figure was checked, then three inline comments demand verification before prod — a direct self-contradiction. Published rent figures are unverified and TODO-style markers violate the no-placeholders rule.
recommended_fix: Verify all figures against the source PDFs, correct the post, and delete every VERIFY marker — or pull the post from the list until verification is complete.

title: Meta description promises 'the gap by area' but the post record contains no area-level data
evidence:
description: "Dublin two-beds average €2,634 on the open market, but the rent cap limits what you can charge a sitting tenant. See the gap by area, and use the free calculator to work out your own limit.",
...
    FigureRow(
      measure: "Dublin asking rent, two-bed apartment",
...
    FigureRow(
      measure: "New-tenancy registered rent, national",
...
    FigureRow(
      measure: "Existing-tenancy registered rent, national",
detail: The SEO description promises an area-level gap, but the constructed post's figures are one Dublin-city metric and two national rows. No per-area data exists anywhere in the record.
recommended_fix: Add per-area figure rows to the post, or drop 'by area' from the description so the snippet matches the page.

title: Body generalizes a two-bed-specific figure to all asking rents
detail: The diff's own source note attributes +1.4% to national two-bed asking rents; the published body presents it as asking rents generally. Segment-specific figure is overstated in copy.
recommended_fix: Qualify the body copy ('two-bed asking rents rose 1.4%') or cite the all-segments national figure.
